problems: missing_required: required target /product_name is not mapped

open_questions: No SKU-like header found in root table; using 'Material code' as identity — confirm

notes: Material is the master product population (12 SKUs); Price history holds price rows keyed by Material code, so the output should be a 12-SKU population joined to the qualifying price rows rather than a 48-row price dump.

Operator requirement fixes the row selection: Price list = RETAIL, Currency = THB, and validity covering 2026-11-03 (inclusive bounds, i.e. Valid from ≤ 2026-11-03 ≤ Valid to). The WHOLESALE and USD rows all sit in the expired 2026-01-01…2026-10-31 window and are excluded.

Material code is profiled as int but displays as zero-padded ('000001'); it must be carried as text so /sku keeps its original zeros, and the same treatment must apply to the join key on the Price history sheet.

Within the qualifying window there appear to be 36 RETAIL/THB rows over 12 SKUs (three rows per SKU). That is not explained by the two price lists or two currencies alone, so some SKUs may have more than one RETAIL/THB price record in the window (duplicate, superseded or tiered rows) — the winning row per SKU must be resolved before output.
Selling price carries no VAT marker, rate column, note or formula in either sheet; whether it is VAT-inclusive is not evidenced by this file and should not be assumed.

tables.reason: Master list: 12 unique Material code values (unique_ratio 1.0) each with one distinct Description, no prices, dates or stock. This is the product population to preserve.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Unique per row (12/12 distinct), sku_like hint, values look like zero-padded codes ('000001'…'000012') even though the profiler typed the column as int; must be read as text to keep leading zeros.

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Unique free-text label per material code ('Coffee variant 01', 'Soap variant 11'); the only descriptive name field in the workbook and matches the contract's 'Product name from the master list'.

tables.reason: Transaction-style price records: Material code repeats 4× per SKU (48 rows / 12 SKUs) with Price list, Currency, Valid from, Valid to and Selling price. No single key column; the natural key is Material code + Price list + validity window, and Material code is the foreign key into Material.

columns.name: Material code
columns.reason: Same value space as the Material sheet's code column (12 distinct, min 1 max 12, same zero-padded format); joins price rows to the master product list. Not an independent SKU source.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Two values only: RETAIL (36 rows) and WHOLESALE (12 rows). Selects which price tier a row belongs to; the operator requirement restricts output to RETAIL, so this is a filter column, not a target field.

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: ISO codes THB (36 rows) / USD (12 rows), consistent with the contract's ISO 4217 currency. Row-varying, so it must be taken from the row; the requirement selects THB rows.

columns.name: Valid from
columns.reason: Two start dates (2026-01-01 ×12, 2026-11-01 ×36) defining price validity windows; used to filter rows valid on 2026-11-03 rather than emitted in the contract.

columns.name: Valid to
columns.reason: Matching end dates (2026-10-31 ×12, 2026-11-30 ×36); with Valid from it forms inclusive validity bounds for the 2026-11-03 filter.

columns.name: Selling price
columns.reason: Numeric amounts 2–256, never empty, 43 distinct of 48; the only money column, so it is the selling price the contract asks for. Confidence capped because the column gives no evidence of VAT treatment or of which rows are the operative RETAIL/THB prices for a SKU.

evidence: root table: sheet 'Price history' (48 rows) classified as products
